dslRule:
<!id: java.io.StringBufferInputStream.to.ByteArrayInputStream>
<!description: Replace deprecated StringBufferInputStream with ByteArrayInputStream and String.getBytes().>
<!severity: WARNING>
java.io.StringBufferInputStream($contents$)
=>
new java.io.ByteArrayInputStream($contents$.getBytes())
;;
